subject: Bridgecore onboarding: evidence capture and PO prerequisites
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.inference.com>

Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.inference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Bridgecore onboarding: evidence capture and PO prerequisites

Hi Samantha —

Thanks for choosing Redwood for the pilot. To get procurement moving we need the vendor onboarding packet completed and a few pieces of insurance evidence before we can issue a full PO. At minimum we require:

- Certificate of Insurance (COI) showing General Liability and Auto limits; Bridgecore must add Redwood Inference, Inc. as Additional Insured on the GL policy.
- Waiver of subrogation on GL and Auto in favor of Redwood where available.
- Cyber/Errors & Omissions coverage: minimum $1,000,000 per occurrence; if Cyber is a separate policy please provide the attestation and policy declaration page.
- W-9 or tax EIN for PO setup.
- Remit/address and preferred invoice email.

If you can provide an endorsement letter from your carrier confirming Additional Insured and primary/non-contributory wording, that will allow us to move to final PO issuance. If the endorsement will take longer, we can discuss a conditional PO for the pilot period but we will need the COI and cyber attestation first.

I've attached our vendor onboarding form — please return it along with the docs. You can upload evidence directly to our procurement portal here: https://procurement.redwood.inference.com/portal/upload/BRG-2026-049

Target for procurement acceptance: within 7 business days of receiving complete evidence.

Appreciate a quick confirmation on timeline from your side.

Best,

Lauren Bishop
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_onboarding_form.pdf
